plan.goal: Validate the UX consistency, navigation flow, and mobile responsiveness of the Notion marketing clone, specifically focusing on the transition between product pillars (Projects, Wikis) and the pricing structure.
plan.summary: The exploration will begin by validating the global navigation and primary CTAs on the landing page. It will then traverse the specific product sub-pages (Projects, Wikis, Templates) to ensure content relevance and consistent header/footer behavior. Finally, it will audit the Pricing page for toggle interactions and FAQ accordions, while simultaneously checking for mobile layout regressions given the prescan warnings about small tap targets.
assumptions: The 'Request a demo' and 'Get Notion free' buttons in the nav trigger modals or external redirects rather than navigating to new HTML files within this static set.
The 'Templates' link maps directly to 'templates-projects.html' as indicated by the href.
The site relies heavily on CSS flex/grid which may break on narrow viewports given the 'small_tap_target' warnings.
risk_hotspots: Global Navigation Bar: High density of links with reported small tap targets (<44px height) on mobile.
Pricing Toggle: Interaction state change between Monthly/Yearly billing.
FAQ Accordions: Expansion/collapse behavior on pricing and template pages.
Mobile Viewport: Layout overflow or unreadable text due to fixed-width elements.

phases.title: Landing Page & Global Nav Validation
phases.objective: Verify the integrity of the home page hero section and the persistence of the global navigation bar.
key_checks: Click 'Projects', 'Wikis', 'Templates', and 'Pricing' links to verify correct routing.
Inspect the 'Get Notion free' and 'Request a demo' buttons for interaction feedback (hover/active states).
Scroll to the bottom to verify footer links match top-level navigation options.
exit_criteria: All top-level nav links successfully route to their respective HTML files.
Hero section CTA is visible and clickable.

phases.title: Product Pillar Deep Dive
phases.objective: Explore the specific feature pages to validate content hierarchy and internal linking strategies.
key_checks: On Projects/Wikis pages, verify that the 'Get Notion free' CTA persists in the hero area.
Check for cross-linking: Does the Projects page link to Wikis and vice versa?
On Templates page, identify if category filters (e.g., 'Roadmaps', 'Issue Tracking') are interactive or static text.
Verify that the 'Back to Home' or Logo click returns to index.html.
exit_criteria: Confirmed presence of primary CTAs on each sub-page.
Validated that internal links do not lead to 404s.

phases.title: Pricing Logic & Interactive Elements
phases.objective: Test dynamic UI components on the Pricing page, specifically toggles and accordions.
key_checks: Interact with the 'Monthly / Yearly' toggle to observe price updates in the plan cards.
Expand at least two FAQ accordion items (e.g., 'How does Notion AI use my data?') to check for layout shifts.
Verify visual distinction between the 'Free', 'Plus', and 'Business' tiers.
exit_criteria: Pricing toggle successfully updates displayed values.
FAQ accordions expand and collapse without breaking layout.

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness & Accessibility Audit
phases.objective: Re-visit critical pages on a mobile viewport to address prescan warnings regarding tap targets.
key_checks: Attempt to tap nav links; verify if they overlap or are too small (<44px).
Check for horizontal scrolling issues on the Pricing table/cards.
Verify readability of hero text on smaller screens.
exit_criteria: No critical layout breakage (overlapping text, unscrollable areas) on mobile.
Documented severity of tap-target issues observed in prescan.

coverage_targets.pages: 100% of known HTML files (index, pricing, projects, wikis, templates-projects)
coverage_targets.features: Nav links, Pricing Toggle, FAQ Accordions, Primary CTAs
coverage_targets.mobile: Critical path (Home -> Pricing) tested on mobile viewport

notes: Prescan indicates 'small_tap_target' warnings on almost all nav items; prioritize checking these in Phase 4.
The 'Request a demo' button uses 'javascript:void(0)', suggesting it may open a modal or do nothing in this static clone; observe console for errors if clicked.
Ensure the browser back-button works correctly when navigating from sub-pages back to Home.
